notes_notes_published_complete.name: notes_notes_published_complete
notes_notes_published_complete.value: not "notes_notes"."is_public" or ("notes_notes"."slug" is not null and "notes_notes"."published_at" is not null)

core_preferences_theme_place.name: core_preferences_theme_place
core_preferences_theme_place.value:
("core_preferences"."theme_lat" is null) = ("core_preferences"."theme_lon" is null)
        and ("core_preferences"."theme_lat" is null or ("core_preferences"."theme_lat" between -90 and 90 and "core_preferences"."theme_lon" between -180 and 180))
        and ("core_preferences"."theme_place" is null or length("core_preferences"."theme_place") <= 80)

tasks_tasks_time_needs_date.name: tasks_tasks_time_needs_date
tasks_tasks_time_needs_date.value: "tasks_tasks"."due_time" is null or "tasks_tasks"."due_date" is not null

tasks_tasks_repeat_needs_date.name: tasks_tasks_repeat_needs_date
tasks_tasks_repeat_needs_date.value: "tasks_tasks"."rrule" is null or "tasks_tasks"."due_date" is not null

documents_documents_reminder_days_valid.name: documents_documents_reminder_days_valid
documents_documents_reminder_days_valid.value: cardinality("documents_documents"."reminder_days") <= 8 and array_position("documents_documents"."reminder_days", null) is null and 0 <= all("documents_documents"."reminder_days") and 730 >= all("documents_documents"."reminder_days")
